{/* MANUAL-CONTENT-START:intro */}
[Plane](https://plane.so/) manages projects, work items, and team planning.

With the Plane block, you can:

- **Manage work**: Create and update projects, work items, states, labels, comments, and attachments.
- **Plan delivery**: Organize cycles, modules, initiatives, releases, estimates, and worklogs.
- **Keep knowledge current**: Manage pages and sync project work items or pages into a Sim knowledge base.
- **React to changes**: Start agents from authenticated Plane webhook events.

Create a personal access token in Plane's profile settings and enter it as the API token. API v2 is the default. For Community Edition or an older self-hosted instance, select API v1 in the advanced settings and set the instance origin, optionally including its reverse-proxy path prefix. Omit `/api/v1` and `/api/v2` from the instance URL. Actions with a current successor share one operation; actions labeled **v1 only** require that API. Resource availability depends on the instance's edition and version.

Explicit empty strings, nulls, and empty arrays can be supplied through **Body Overrides** using the action's canonical input names. Clearing work item labels and assignees is verified through API v1 because Plane v2 can continue returning deleted relationship IDs. The update action returns the verified cleared state; subsequent v2 reads may still include those IDs. Use API v1 when reading active relationships after a clear.

For webhooks, automatic registration requires API v2. On instances using API v1, create a webhook in Plane's settings and configure its signing secret in Sim. Project-filtered legacy deletion events that omit their project cannot be matched and are skipped.

The knowledge connector reads API v1 to include full descriptions. It preserves existing documents when a listing is capped and disables automatic deletion reconciliation because offset listings can shift during concurrent changes. Project pages require an edition that exposes the pages API.

In Sim, the Plane block lets your agents triage work, plan delivery, and keep project knowledge available.
{/* MANUAL-CONTENT-END */}


## Usage Instructions

Connect Plane Cloud or a self-hosted Plane instance. API v2 is the default; choose API v1 for Community Edition or older instances. Actions with a current successor are consolidated. Unsupported version-specific inputs fail explicitly. Manage work items, projects, cycles, modules, states, labels, comments, links, attachments, pages, collections, initiatives, epics, releases, customers, estimates, worklogs, intake, members, invitations, and workspace administration. Availability of advanced resources depends on the Plane edition and version.

### Plane Archive a work item

Archive a work item in Plane. Requires API v2.

#### Input

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --------- | ---- | -------- | ----------- |
| `apiKey` | string | Yes | Plane personal access token from Profile → API tokens. |
| `baseUrl` | string | No | Plane instance origin, optionally with a reverse-proxy path prefix. Defaults to https://api.plane.so. Do not include /api/v1 or /api/v2. |
| `apiVersion` | string | No | API version: v2 \(default\) for Plane Cloud and current commercial instances; v1 for Community Edition or older self-hosted instances. Unsupported operations or fields fail explicitly. |
| `workspace_slug` | string | Yes | Workspace slug from the Plane URL \(for example, my-team\). |
| `project_id` | string | Yes | The project the work item belongs to. |
| `pk` | string | Yes | The work item's UUID. This lookup is UUID-only — a `PROJ-142` identifier here returns `404`. |
| `fields` | string | No | Comma-separated list of fields to return. Unrequested keys are **omitted** from the response, not returned as `null`, so absent means "not requested" and `null` means "actually null". `id` always comes back whether or not you name it. Pass `all` for every requestable field. An unknown name is a `400` that lists the valid set and suggests the closest match, so a typo can't silently cost you the saving. Requestable here: `archived_at`, `assignee_ids`, `created_at`, `created_by_id`, `custom_fields`, `cycle_id`, `id`, `identifier`, `is_draft`, `label_ids`, `module_ids`, `name`, `parent_id`, `priority`, `project_id`, `sequence_id`, `start_date`, `state_id`, `target_date`, `type_id`. See \[Sparse fields\]\(/api-reference/v2/sparse-fields\). |
| `expand` | string | No | Comma-separated relations to embed alongside the ids: `assignees` \(the assigned users\), `cycle` \(the cycle it belongs to\), `labels` \(the applied labels\), `modules` \(the modules it belongs to\), `parent` \(its parent work item\), `state` \(the work item's state object\), `type` \(its work item type\). Expansion is separate-key: `?expand=state` keeps `state_id` and adds a `state` object next to it, so an id is never replaced by an object. An unknown value is a `400`. `?fields=` and `?expand=` are independent namespaces. Relation names are not valid `?fields=` tokens \(and vice versa\), and an expanded object survives field filtering — `?fields=id,name&expand=state` returns `id`, `name` and `state`. See \[Expanding relations\]\(/api-reference/v2/expanding-relations\). |

#### Output

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --------- | ---- | ----------- |
| `result` | object | Plane V2 Work- Items |
|   ↳ `id` | string | Unique identifier for the work item. This is the `\{pk\}` on every project-scoped detail route. |
|   ↳ `name` | string | Title of the work item. Maximum 255 characters. |
|   ↳ `identifier` | string | The human key, for example `PROJ-142`. It is the project's identifier joined to `sequence_id`, and it is what people paste into chat and commit messages. Use it with \[Get a work item by identifier\]\(/api-reference/v2/work-items/get-work-item-by-identifier\) when you don't have the project UUID. |
|   ↳ `sequence_id` | number | The work item's number within its project. Assigned by Plane and never reused. |
|   ↳ `priority` | string | One of `urgent`, `high`, `medium`, `low`, or `none`. Never null — an unprioritized work item reads `none`. |
|   ↳ `state_id` | string | The workflow state the work item is currently in. |
|   ↳ `type_id` | string | Type id |
|   ↳ `assignee_ids` | array | User ids assigned to the work item. Empty array when unassigned. |
|   ↳ `label_ids` | array | Label ids applied to the work item. Empty array when unlabeled. |
|   ↳ `parent_id` | string | The parent work item, or `null` for a top-level item. A parent may live in another project of the same workspace. |
|   ↳ `start_date` | string | Start date |
|   ↳ `target_date` | string | Target date |
|   ↳ `is_draft` | boolean | Whether the work item is still a draft. Drafts are created in the Plane app and are excluded from most boards. |
|   ↳ `archived_at` | string | Archived at |
|   ↳ `created_at` | string | When the work item was created. |
|   ↳ `created_by_id` | string | Created by id |
|   ↳ `custom_fields` | json | Custom fields |
|   ↳ `assignees` | array | Assignees |
|     ↳ `id` | string | Asset Id |
|     ↳ `display_name` | string | Asset Id |
|     ↳ `avatar_url` | string | Asset Id |
|     ↳ `email` | string | Asset Id |
|   ↳ `cycle` | json | Cycle |
|   ↳ `labels` | array | Labels |
|     ↳ `id` | string | Asset Id |
|     ↳ `name` | string | Asset Id |
|     ↳ `color` | string | Asset Id |
|   ↳ `modules` | array | Modules |
|   ↳ `parent` | object | Parent |
|     ↳ `id` | string | Asset Id |
|     ↳ `name` | string | Asset Id |
|     ↳ `sequence_id` | number | Access |
|   ↳ `state` | object | State |
|     ↳ `id` | string | Asset Id |
|     ↳ `name` | string | Asset Id |
|     ↳ `color` | string | Asset Id |
|     ↳ `group` | string | Asset Id |
|   ↳ `type` | object | Type |
|     ↳ `id` | string | Asset Id |
|     ↳ `name` | string | Asset Id |
|     ↳ `logo_props` | json | Logo Props |
|     ↳ `is_epic` | boolean | Has Pages |

### Plane Attach a property to a type

Attach a property to a type in Plane. Requires API v2.

#### Input

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --------- | ---- | -------- | ----------- |
| `apiKey` | string | Yes | Plane personal access token from Profile → API tokens. |
| `baseUrl` | string | No | Plane instance origin, optionally with a reverse-proxy path prefix. Defaults to https://api.plane.so. Do not include /api/v1 or /api/v2. |
| `apiVersion` | string | No | API version: v2 \(default\) for Plane Cloud and current commercial instances; v1 for Community Edition or older self-hosted instances. Unsupported operations or fields fail explicitly. |
| `bodyOverrides` | json | No | JSON overrides using the canonical input names for the selected API version. Preserves empty strings, null, and empty arrays; unsupported fields are rejected. |
| `workspace_slug` | string | Yes | Workspace slug from the Plane URL \(for example, my-team\). |
| `project_id` | string | Yes | The project the work item type belongs to. |
| `type_id` | string | Yes | The work item type to attach the properties to. |
| `properties` | json | Yes | The ids of the properties to attach. Every id must belong to a property in **this project** — an id from another project or another workspace fails the whole request with `400 invalid_request`, and nothing is attached. Nothing is attached partially: either all the ids are valid or none are applied. The array cannot be empty. Attaching an id the type already exposes is not an error and does not create a duplicate, so retrying a request that may have already landed is safe. |

#### Output

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --------- | ---- | ----------- |
| `result` | object | Plane V2 V2 Attach Type Propertyresult |
|   ↳ `properties` | array | Properties |

### Plane Attach properties to a workspace type

Attach properties to a workspace type in Plane. Requires API v2.

#### Input

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --------- | ---- | -------- | ----------- |
| `apiKey` | string | Yes | Plane personal access token from Profile → API tokens. |
| `baseUrl` | string | No | Plane instance origin, optionally with a reverse-proxy path prefix. Defaults to https://api.plane.so. Do not include /api/v1 or /api/v2. |
| `apiVersion` | string | No | API version: v2 \(default\) for Plane Cloud and current commercial instances; v1 for Community Edition or older self-hosted instances. Unsupported operations or fields fail explicitly. |
| `bodyOverrides` | json | No | JSON overrides using the canonical input names for the selected API version. Preserves empty strings, null, and empty arrays; unsupported fields are rejected. |
| `workspace_slug` | string | Yes | Workspace slug from the Plane URL \(for example, my-team\). |
| `type_id` | string | Yes | The workspace work item type to attach the properties to. |
| `properties` | json | Yes | Ids of properties to attach, taken from the workspace property catalog. Send the whole set you want in one call rather than one request per property. Every id must already exist in this workspace. An unknown id — including one that belongs to another workspace — fails the request with `400 invalid_request`; nothing is attached, and a cross-tenant id is never silently linked. |

#### Output

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --------- | ---- | ----------- |
| `result` | object | Plane V2 V2 Attach Workspace Type Propertyresult |
|   ↳ `properties` | array | Properties |

### Plane Bulk create comments

Bulk create comments in Plane. Requires API v2.

#### Input

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --------- | ---- | -------- | ----------- |
| `apiKey` | string | Yes | Plane personal access token from Profile → API tokens. |
| `baseUrl` | string | No | Plane instance origin, optionally with a reverse-proxy path prefix. Defaults to https://api.plane.so. Do not include /api/v1 or /api/v2. |
| `apiVersion` | string | No | API version: v2 \(default\) for Plane Cloud and current commercial instances; v1 for Community Edition or older self-hosted instances. Unsupported operations or fields fail explicitly. |
| `bodyOverrides` | json | No | JSON overrides using the canonical input names for the selected API version. Preserves empty strings, null, and empty arrays; unsupported fields are rejected. |
| `workspace_slug` | string | Yes | Workspace slug from the Plane URL \(for example, my-team\). |
| `project_id` | string | Yes | The project the comments belong to. Accepts the project UUID or its bare identifier, for example `ENG`. |
| `work_item_id` | string | Yes | The work item the comments hang off. Accepts the work item UUID or its `PROJ-123` identifier. |
| `items` | json | Yes | The comments to create — each entry takes the same body as \[Create a comment\]\(/api-reference/v2/work-item-comments/create-comment\). Between 1 and **50** per call. |
| `all_or_none` | boolean | No | Defaults to `false`. Leave it off for partial success: each row runs in its own savepoint, successful rows commit, and you read the breakdown. Set it to `true` to make the batch atomic. Every row is still evaluated, but if **any** row fails the whole batch is discarded and the call answers `409` instead of the `200` envelope. Side effects scheduled by the rows follow the same outcome. |

#### Output

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --------- | ---- | ----------- |
| `result` | object | Plane V2 V2 Bulk Create Commentsresult |
|   ↳ `results` | array | Results |
|     ↳ `index` | number | Access |
|     ↳ `result` | string | Asset Id |
|     ↳ `id` | string | Asset Id |
|     ↳ `type` | string | Asset Id |
|     ↳ `code` | string | Asset Id |
|     ↳ `detail` | string | Asset Id |
|     ↳ `errors` | array | Errors |
|       ↳ `field` | string | Asset Id |
|       ↳ `code` | string | Asset Id |
|       ↳ `message` | string | Asset Id |
|   ↳ `succeeded` | number | Succeeded |
|   ↳ `failed` | number | Failed |

| `all_or_none` | boolean | No | Defaults to `false`. Leave it off for partial success: each row runs in its own savepoint, successful rows commit, and you read the breakdown. Set it to `true` to make the batch atomic. Every row is still evaluated, but if **any** row fails the whole batch is discarded and the call answers `409` instead of the `200` envelope. Side effects scheduled by the rows follow the same outcome. |

#### Output

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --------- | ---- | ----------- |
| `result` | object | Plane V2 V2 Bulk Update Work Itemsresult |
|   ↳ `results` | array | Results |
|     ↳ `index` | number | Access |
|     ↳ `result` | string | Asset Id |
|     ↳ `id` | string | Asset Id |
|     ↳ `type` | string | Asset Id |
|     ↳ `code` | string | Asset Id |
|     ↳ `detail` | string | Asset Id |
|   ↳ `succeeded` | number | Succeeded |
|   ↳ `failed` | number | Failed |

### Plane Create an artifact

Create an artifact in Plane. Requires API v2.

#### Input

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --------- | ---- | -------- | ----------- |
| `apiKey` | string | Yes | Plane personal access token from Profile → API tokens. |
| `baseUrl` | string | No | Plane instance origin, optionally with a reverse-proxy path prefix. Defaults to https://api.plane.so. Do not include /api/v1 or /api/v2. |
| `apiVersion` | string | No | API version: v2 \(default\) for Plane Cloud and current commercial instances; v1 for Community Edition or older self-hosted instances. Unsupported operations or fields fail explicitly. |
| `bodyOverrides` | json | No | JSON overrides using the canonical input names for the selected API version. Preserves empty strings, null, and empty arrays; unsupported fields are rejected. |
| `workspace_slug` | string | Yes | Workspace slug from the Plane URL \(for example, my-team\). |
| `html` | string | Yes | The rendered HTML for version 1. This is the only genuinely required field — an empty or missing value is a `400`. |
| `name` | string | No | Display name. Truncated to 255 characters. Falls back to `Untitled dashboard` when omitted, empty, or whitespace — it never rejects a missing name. |
| `description` | string | No | Free-form description. Truncated to 2000 characters rather than rejected. |
| `prompt` | string | No | The prompt that produced this HTML, stored against the version for provenance. Not returned by any read endpoint. |
| `project` | string | No | Optionally scope the artifact to a project. Note the field is `project`, not `project_id` — the `*_id` convention used elsewhere in v2 does not apply on this surface. |
| `data_mode` | string | No | How the artifact's data is sourced. One of `snapshot` \(frozen at generation time\) or `live` \(re-read on view\). Defaults to `snapshot`. Any other value is a `400`. |

#### Output

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --------- | ---- | ----------- |
| `result` | object | Plane V2 Artifacts |
|   ↳ `id` | string | Unique identifier for the artifact. |
|   ↳ `name` | string | Display name. Maximum 255 characters. Defaults to `Untitled dashboard` when created without one. |
|   ↳ `description` | string | Free-form description. Maximum 2000 characters. Returned on the detail read only. |
|   ↳ `current_version` | number | Which version is current. Starts at `1` and increments by one each time you append a version. |
|   ↳ `data_mode` | string | How the artifact's data is sourced — `snapshot` \(data frozen at generation time\) or `live` \(re-read on view\). Defaults to `snapshot`. |
|   ↳ `html` | string | The rendered HTML of the **current** version. Returned on the detail read only. |
|   ↳ `is_published` | boolean | Whether the artifact has a public anchor. Returned on create. |
|   ↳ `anchor` | string | Anchor |

### Plane Create a comment

Create a comment in Plane. Supports API v1 compatibility.

#### Input

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --------- | ---- | -------- | ----------- |
| `apiKey` | string | Yes | Plane personal access token from Profile → API tokens. |
| `baseUrl` | string | No | Plane instance origin, optionally with a reverse-proxy path prefix. Defaults to https://api.plane.so. Do not include /api/v1 or /api/v2. |
| `apiVersion` | string | No | API version: v2 \(default\) for Plane Cloud and current commercial instances; v1 for Community Edition or older self-hosted instances. Unsupported operations or fields fail explicitly. |
| `bodyOverrides` | json | No | JSON overrides using the canonical input names for the selected API version. Preserves empty strings, null, and empty arrays; unsupported fields are rejected. |
| `workspace_slug` | string | Yes | Workspace slug from the Plane URL \(for example, my-team\). |
| `project_id` | string | Yes | The project the work item belongs to. |
| `work_item_id` | string | Yes | The work item to comment on. |
| `comment_html` | string | No | The comment body, as HTML — for example `Deployed the fix to staging.`. Plane derives the plain-text `comment_stripped` from it server-side, which is what search matches. |
| `access` | string | No | Visibility of the comment. - `INTERNAL` — visible to the project team - `EXTERNAL` — marked as visible outside the team, for example on a published project Omit it to take the server's default. Change it later with a `PATCH`. |
| `external_id` | string | No | Your system's identifier for this comment, for sync and import correlation. Maximum 255 characters. Accepts `null`. |
| `external_source` | string | No | The system `external_id` came from, for example `github` or `zendesk`. Maximum 255 characters. Accepts `null`. |
| `fields` | string | No | Comma-separated list of fields to return. Unrequested keys are **omitted** from the response, not returned as `null`, so absent means "not requested" and `null` means "actually null". `id` always comes back whether or not you name it. Pass `all` for every requestable field. An unknown name is a `400` that lists the valid set and suggests the closest match, so a typo can't silently cost you the saving. Requestable here: `access`, `actor_id`, `comment_html`, `comment_stripped`, `created_at`, `created_by_id`, `edited_at`, `external_id`, `external_source`, `id`, `work_item_id`. See \[Sparse fields\]\(/api-reference/v2/sparse-fields\). |
| `expand` | string | No | Comma-separated relations to embed alongside the ids: `actor` \(the comment author\). Expansion is separate-key: `?expand=state` keeps `state_id` and adds a `state` object next to it, so an id is never replaced by an object. An unknown value is a `400`. `?fields=` and `?expand=` are independent namespaces. Relation names are not valid `?fields=` tokens \(and vice versa\), and an expanded object survives field filtering — `?fields=id,name&expand=state` returns `id`, `name` and `state`. See \[Expanding relations\]\(/api-reference/v2/expanding-relations\). |
| `comment_json` | json | No | v1 compatibility only. Comment json. |
| `created_at` | string | No | v1 compatibility only. Creation timestamp for imports. |
| `created_by` | string | No | v1 compatibility only. Original creator user ID for imports. |

#### Output

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --------- | ---- | ----------- |
| `result` | object | Plane V2 Work- Item- Comments |
|   ↳ `id` | json | Id |
|   ↳ `work_item_id` | string | The work item this comment is attached to. Always matches the `work_item_id` in the request path. |
|   ↳ `comment_html` | json | Comment html |
|   ↳ `comment_stripped` | json | Comment stripped |
|   ↳ `access` | json | Access |
|   ↳ `actor_id` | string | Actor id |
|   ↳ `external_id` | string | External id |
|   ↳ `external_source` | string | External source |
|   ↳ `edited_at` | string | Edited at |
|   ↳ `created_at` | json | Created at |
|   ↳ `created_by_id` | string | Created by id |
|   ↳ `actor` | json | Actor |
|   ↳ `is_member` | boolean | Is member |
|   ↳ `updated_at` | string | Updated at |
|   ↳ `deleted_at` | string | Deleted at |
|   ↳ `attachments` | array | Attachments |
|   ↳ `created_by` | string | Created by |
|   ↳ `updated_by` | string | Updated by |
|   ↳ `project` | string | Project |
|   ↳ `workspace` | string | Workspace |
|   ↳ `issue` | string | Issue |
|   ↳ `parent` | string | Parent |
|   ↳ `description` | string | Description |
|   ↳ `comment_json` | object | Comment json |

### Plane Create a cycle

Create a cycle in Plane. Supports API v1 compatibility.

#### Input

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --------- | ---- | -------- | ----------- |
| `apiKey` | string | Yes | Plane personal access token from Profile → API tokens. |
| `baseUrl` | string | No | Plane instance origin, optionally with a reverse-proxy path prefix. Defaults to https://api.plane.so. Do not include /api/v1 or /api/v2. |
| `apiVersion` | string | No | API version: v2 \(default\) for Plane Cloud and current commercial instances; v1 for Community Edition or older self-hosted instances. Unsupported operations or fields fail explicitly. |
| `bodyOverrides` | json | No | JSON overrides using the canonical input names for the selected API version. Preserves empty strings, null, and empty arrays; unsupported fields are rejected. |
| `workspace_slug` | string | Yes | Workspace slug from the Plane URL \(for example, my-team\). |
| `project_id` | string | Yes | The project to add the cycle to. |
| `name` | string | Yes | Display name for the cycle, unique within the project. Maximum 255 characters. |
| `description` | string | No | Free-form description of what the cycle covers. |
| `start_date` | string | No | When the cycle opens, as an ISO 8601 date-time. Nullable — omit it or send `null` for an unscheduled cycle. |
| `end_date` | string | No | When the cycle closes, as an ISO 8601 date-time. Nullable. |
| `timezone` | string | No | The IANA time zone the cycle's dates are interpreted in, for example `America/New_York`, `Asia/Kolkata`, `Europe/London`, or `UTC`. Set it to the team's working zone so a cycle boundary lands at local midnight instead of UTC midnight. Any value outside the IANA list is rejected with `400 invalid_request`. |
| `sort_order` | number | No | Ordering weight for the cycle within the project. Lower values sort first when you list with `?order_by=sort_order`. |
| `logo_props` | json | No | JSON blob holding the cycle's icon configuration, as written by Plane clients. Stored and returned unchanged. |
| `external_id` | string | No | Your system's identifier for this cycle, for sync and import correlation. Maximum 255 characters. You can find the cycle again later with `?external_id=` on \[List cycles\]\(/api-reference/v2/cycles/list-cycles\). |
| `external_source` | string | No | The system `external_id` came from, for example `jira` or `linear`. Maximum 255 characters. |
| `fields` | string | No | Comma-separated list of fields to return. Unrequested keys are **omitted** from the response, not returned as `null`, so absent means "not requested" and `null` means "actually null". `id` always comes back whether or not you name it. Pass `all` for every requestable field. An unknown name is a `400` that lists the valid set and suggests the closest match, so a typo can't silently cost you the saving. Requestable here: `created_at`, `created_by_id`, `description`, `end_date`, `external_id`, `external_source`, `id`, `logo_props`, `name`, `owned_by_id`, `sort_order`, `start_date`, `timezone`. See \[Sparse fields\]\(/api-reference/v2/sparse-fields\). |
| `expand` | string | No | Comma-separated relations to embed alongside the ids: `owned_by` \(the cycle owner\). Expansion is separate-key: `?expand=state` keeps `state_id` and adds a `state` object next to it, so an id is never replaced by an object. An unknown value is a `400`. `?fields=` and `?expand=` are independent namespaces. Relation names are not valid `?fields=` tokens \(and vice versa\), and an expanded object survives field filtering — `?fields=id,name&expand=state` returns `id`, `name` and `state`. See \[Expanding relations\]\(/api-reference/v2/expanding-relations\). |
| `owned_by` | string | No | v1 compatibility only. Cycle owner user ID; defaults to the authenticated user. |

#### Output

| --------- | ---- | ----------- |
| `result` | object | Plane V2 Cycles |
|   ↳ `id` | json | Id |
|   ↳ `name` | string | Display name, unique within the project. Maximum 255 characters. |
|   ↳ `description` | json | Description |

|   ↳ `created_at` | json | Created at |

|   ↳ `owned_by` | json | Owned by |

### Plane Create a label

Create a label in Plane. Supports API v1 compatibility.

#### Input

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --------- | ---- | -------- | ----------- |
| `apiKey` | string | Yes | Plane personal access token from Profile → API tokens. |
| `baseUrl` | string | No | Plane instance origin, optionally with a reverse-proxy path prefix. Defaults to https://api.plane.so. Do not include /api/v1 or /api/v2. |
| `apiVersion` | string | No | API version: v2 \(default\) for Plane Cloud and current commercial instances; v1 for Community Edition or older self-hosted instances. Unsupported operations or fields fail explicitly. |
| `bodyOverrides` | json | No | JSON overrides using the canonical input names for the selected API version. Preserves empty strings, null, and empty arrays; unsupported fields are rejected. |
| `workspace_slug` | string | Yes | Workspace slug from the Plane URL \(for example, my-team\). |
| `project_id` | string | Yes | The project to add the label to. |
| `name` | string | Yes | Display name for the label, unique within the project. Maximum 255 characters. |
| `color` | string | No | Hex color used wherever the label is rendered, for example `#e5484d`. Maximum 255 characters. Send one if the label needs to be recognizable at a glance on a board. |
| `description` | string | No | Free-form note about what the label is for and when to apply it. |
| `parent_id` | string | No | The label this one nests under, for grouping related tags such as `Billing` and `Search` beneath an `Area` label. The parent must be a label in the same project — an id from another project is a `400`, not a silent link. Omit it, or send `null`, for a top-level label. |
| `sort_order` | number | No | Ordering weight within the project. Lower values sort first. Assigned automatically when omitted, so send it only when you are recreating a specific order. |
| `external_id` | string | No | Your system's identifier for this label, for sync and import correlation. Maximum 255 characters. Store it here and you can find the label later with `?external_id=`, without keeping a map of Plane ids. |
| `external_source` | string | No | The system `external_id` came from, for example `github` or `jira`. Maximum 255 characters. |
| `fields` | string | No | Comma-separated list of fields to return. Unrequested keys are **omitted** from the response, not returned as `null`, so absent means "not requested" and `null` means "actually null". `id` always comes back whether or not you name it. Pass `all` for every requestable field. An unknown name is a `400` that lists the valid set and suggests the closest match, so a typo can't silently cost you the saving. Requestable here: `color`, `created_at`, `created_by_id`, `description`, `external_id`, `external_source`, `id`, `name`, `parent_id`, `sort_order`. See \[Sparse fields\]\(/api-reference/v2/sparse-fields\). |

#### Output

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --------- | ---- | ----------- |
| `result` | object | Plane V2 Labels |
|   ↳ `id` | json | Id |
|   ↳ `name` | string | Display name, unique within the project. Maximum 255 characters. |
|   ↳ `description` | json | Description |
|   ↳ `color` | json | Color |
|   ↳ `sort_order` | json | Sort order |
|   ↳ `parent_id` | string | Parent id |
|   ↳ `external_id` | string | External id |
|   ↳ `external_source` | string | External source |
|   ↳ `created_at` | json | Created at |
|   ↳ `created_by_id` | string | Created by id |
|   ↳ `updated_at` | string | Updated at |
|   ↳ `deleted_at` | string | Deleted at |
|   ↳ `created_by` | string | Created by |
|   ↳ `updated_by` | string | Updated by |
|   ↳ `workspace` | string | Workspace |
|   ↳ `project` | string | Project |
|   ↳ `parent` | string | Parent |
|   ↳ `deleted_by` | json | Deleted by |

#### Input

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --------- | ---- | -------- | ----------- |
| `apiKey` | string | Yes | Plane personal access token from Profile → API tokens. |
| `baseUrl` | string | No | Plane instance origin, optionally with a reverse-proxy path prefix. Defaults to https://api.plane.so. Do not include /api/v1 or /api/v2. |
| `apiVersion` | string | No | API version: v2 \(default\) for Plane Cloud and current commercial instances; v1 for Community Edition or older self-hosted instances. Unsupported operations or fields fail explicitly. |
| `bodyOverrides` | json | No | JSON overrides using the canonical input names for the selected API version. Preserves empty strings, null, and empty arrays; unsupported fields are rejected. |
| `workspace_slug` | string | Yes | Workspace slug from the Plane URL \(for example, my-team\). |
| `project_id` | string | Yes | The project to create the module in. |
| `name` | string | Yes | Display name for the module, unique within the project. Maximum 255 characters. |
| `description` | string | No | Plain-text summary of what the module covers. |
| `status` | string | No | Where the module sits in its lifecycle. - `backlog` — Captured, not yet committed to - `planned` — Committed to but not started - `in-progress` — Actively being worked on - `paused` — Started, then put on hold - `completed` — Delivered - `cancelled` — Dropped without delivering Defaults to `planned` when omitted. | `start_date` | string | No | Date the module is scheduled to begin, as `YYYY-MM-DD`. Nullable. |
| `target_date` | string | No | Date the module is expected to land, as `YYYY-MM-DD`. Nullable, and must not be earlier than `start_date`. |
| `lead_id` | string | No | The user accountable for the module. Must be a member of this project — any other user id is rejected with a `400` naming `lead_id`, never linked silently. Nullable. |
| `sort_order` | number | No | Ordering weight used when modules are listed. Lower values sort first. In a project that already has modules, Plane positions the new module ahead of them on create, so send `sort_order` in a follow-up `PATCH` if you need a specific slot. |
| `logo_props` | json | No | Free-form JSON object holding the icon Plane renders for the module. |
| `external_id` | string | No | Your system's identifier for this module, for sync and import correlation. Maximum 255 characters. Nullable. |
| `external_source` | string | No | The system `external_id` came from, for example `github` or `jira`. Maximum 255 characters. Nullable. |
| `fields` | string | No | Comma-separated list of fields to return. Unrequested keys are **omitted** from the response, not returned as `null`, so absent means "not requested" and `null` means "actually null". `id` always comes back whether or not you name it. Pass `all` for every requestable field. An unknown name is a `400` that lists the valid set and suggests the closest match, so a typo can't silently cost you the saving. Requestable here: `archived_at`, `created_at`, `created_by_id`, `description`, `external_id`, `external_source`, `id`, `lead_id`, `logo_props`, `member_ids`, `name`, `sort_order`, `start_date`, `status`, `target_date`. See \[Sparse fields\]\(/api-reference/v2/sparse-fields\). |
| `expand` | string | No | Comma-separated relations to embed alongside the ids: `lead` \(the module lead\), `members` \(the module members\). Expansion is separate-key: `?expand=state` keeps `state_id` and adds a `state` object next to it, so an id is never replaced by an object. An unknown value is a `400`. `?fields=` and `?expand=` are independent namespaces. Relation names are not valid `?fields=` tokens \(and vice versa\), and an expanded object survives field filtering — `?fields=id,name&expand=state` returns `id`, `name` and `state`. See \[Expanding relations\]\(/api-reference/v2/expanding-relations\). |
| `members` | json | No | v1 compatibility only. Members. |

#### Output

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --------- | ---- | ----------- |
| `result` | object | Plane V2 Modules |
|   ↳ `id` | json | Id |
|   ↳ `name` | string | Display name, unique within the project. Maximum 255 characters. |
|   ↳ `description` | json | Description |
|   ↳ `status` | json | Status |
|   ↳ `start_date` | string | Start date |
|   ↳ `target_date` | string | Target date |
|   ↳ `lead_id` | string | Lead id |
|   ↳ `member_ids` | array | Project members assigned to the module. Read-only in v2 — module membership is not yet writable through the v2 API. |
|   ↳ `sort_order` | json | Sort order |
|   ↳ `logo_props` | json | Logo props |
|   ↳ `external_id` | string | External id |
|   ↳ `external_source` | string | External source |
|   ↳ `archived_at` | string | Archived at |
|   ↳ `created_at` | json | Created at |
|   ↳ `created_by_id` | string | The user who created the module. |
|   ↳ `lead` | json | Lead |
|   ↳ `members` | array | Members |
|   ↳ `total_issues` | json | Total issues |
|   ↳ `cancelled_issues` | json | Cancelled issues |
|   ↳ `completed_issues` | json | Completed issues |
|   ↳ `started_issues` | json | Started issues |
|   ↳ `unstarted_issues` | json | Unstarted issues |
|   ↳ `backlog_issues` | json | Backlog issues |
|   ↳ `updated_at` | string | Updated at |
|   ↳ `deleted_at` | string | Deleted at |
|   ↳ `description_text` | json | Description text |
|   ↳ `description_html` | json | Description html |
|   ↳ `view_props` | json | View props |
|   ↳ `created_by` | string | Created by |
|   ↳ `updated_by` | string | Updated by |
|   ↳ `project` | string | Project |
|   ↳ `workspace` | string | Workspace |
|   ↳ `deleted_by` | json | Deleted by |

### Plane Create a project

Create a project in Plane. Supports API v1 compatibility.

#### Input

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --------- | ---- | -------- | ----------- |
| `apiKey` | string | Yes | Plane personal access token from Profile → API tokens. |
| `baseUrl` | string | No | Plane instance origin, optionally with a reverse-proxy path prefix. Defaults to https://api.plane.so. Do not include /api/v1 or /api/v2. |
| `apiVersion` | string | No | API version: v2 \(default\) for Plane Cloud and current commercial instances; v1 for Community Edition or older self-hosted instances. Unsupported operations or fields fail explicitly. |
| `bodyOverrides` | json | No | JSON overrides using the canonical input names for the selected API version. Preserves empty strings, null, and empty arrays; unsupported fields are rejected. |
| `workspace_slug` | string | Yes | Workspace slug from the Plane URL \(for example, my-team\). |
| `identifier` | string | Yes | Short project key used to prefix work item numbers, for example `ENG` in `ENG-142`. Maximum 255 characters. |
| `name` | string | Yes | Display name. Maximum 255 characters. |
| `archive_in` | number | No | The archive in. |
| `close_in` | number | No | The close in. |
| `cover_image` | string | No | URL of the cover image. Nullable. |
| `cycle_view` | boolean | No | Whether cycle view. |
| `default_assignee_id` | string | No | Id of the related default assignee. Nullable. |
| `default_state_id` | string | No | Id of the related default state. Nullable. |
| `description` | string | No | Free-form description. |
| `emoji` | string | No | Emoji shown alongside the name. Maximum 255 characters. Nullable. |
| `estimate_id` | string | No | Id of the related estimate. Nullable. |
| `external_id` | string | No | Your system's identifier for this record, for sync and import correlation. Maximum 255 characters. Nullable. |
| `external_source` | string | No | The system `external_id` came from, for example `github` or `jira`. Maximum 255 characters. Nullable. |
| `guest_view_all_features` | boolean | No | Whether guest view all features. |
| `icon_prop` | string | No | The icon prop. Nullable. |
| `intake_view` | boolean | No | Whether intake view. |
| `is_issue_type_enabled` | boolean | No | Whether is issue type enabled. |
| `is_time_tracking_enabled` | boolean | No | Whether is time tracking enabled. |
| `issue_views_view` | boolean | No | Whether issue views view. |
| `logo_props` | string | No | Editor-owned logo descriptor. Pass back what you read rather than composing it by hand. |
| `module_view` | boolean | No | Whether module view. |
| `network` | string | No | Project visibility: `0` is private to members, `2` is visible to the whole workspace. |
| `page_view` | boolean | No | Whether page view. |
| `priority` | string | No | - `none` - None - `low` - Low - `medium` - Medium - `high` - High - `urgent` - Urgent One of `none`, `low`, `medium`, `high`, `urgent`. |

### Plane Create a project project automation

Create a project project automation in Plane. Requires API v2.

#### Input

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --------- | ---- | -------- | ----------- |
| `apiKey` | string | Yes | Plane personal access token from Profile → API tokens. |
| `baseUrl` | string | No | Plane instance origin, optionally with a reverse-proxy path prefix. Defaults to https://api.plane.so. Do not include /api/v1 or /api/v2. |
| `apiVersion` | string | No | API version: v2 \(default\) for Plane Cloud and current commercial instances; v1 for Community Edition or older self-hosted instances. Unsupported operations or fields fail explicitly. |
| `bodyOverrides` | json | No | JSON overrides using the canonical input names for the selected API version. Preserves empty strings, null, and empty arrays; unsupported fields are rejected. |
| `workspace_slug` | string | Yes | Workspace slug from the Plane URL \(for example, my-team\). |
| `project_id` | string | Yes | The project the resource belongs to. Accepts the project UUID or its bare identifier, for example `ENG`. |
| `name` | string | Yes | Human-readable automation name Maximum 255 characters. |
| `scope` | string | Yes | The scope defines on what entity this automation runs on \(e.g., WorkItem, Cycle, Module\) Maximum 50 characters. |
| `description` | string | No | Automation description |
| `project_ids` | json | No | Ids of the projects to associate. Replaces the current set. |
| `fields` | string | No | Comma-separated list of fields to return. Unrequested keys are **omitted**, not returned as `null`. `id` always comes back. Pass `all` for every requestable field. An unknown name is a `400`. See \[Sparse fields\]\(/api-reference/v2/sparse-fields\). Requestable here: `bot_user_id`, `created_at`, `created_by_id`, `current_version_id`, `description`, `id`, `is_enabled`, `is_global`, `last_run_at`, `name`, `project_ids`, `run_count`, `scope`, `status`, `updated_at`. |

#### Output

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --------- | ---- | ----------- |
| `result` | object | Plane V2 Project- Automations |
|   ↳ `actor_id` | string | The related actor. |
|   ↳ `automation_edge_id` | string | The related automation edge. |
|   ↳ `automation_id` | string | The related automation. |
|   ↳ `automation_node_id` | string | The related automation node. |
|   ↳ `automation_run_id` | string | The related automation run. |
|   ↳ `automation_scope` | string | The automation scope. |
|   ↳ `automation_version_id` | string | The related automation version. |
|   ↳ `created_at` | string | When the record was created. |
|   ↳ `epoch` | number | The epoch. |
|   ↳ `field` | string | The field. |
|   ↳ `id` | string | Unique identifier. |
|   ↳ `new_identifier` | string | The new identifier. |
|   ↳ `new_value` | string | The new value. |
|   ↳ `node_execution_id` | string | The related node execution. |
|   ↳ `old_identifier` | string | The old identifier. |
|   ↳ `old_value` | string | The old value. |
|   ↳ `verb` | string | The verb. |
|   ↳ `bot_user_id` | string | Bot user id |
|   ↳ `created_by_id` | string | Created by id |
|   ↳ `current_version_id` | string | Current version id |
|   ↳ `description` | string | Description |
|   ↳ `is_enabled` | boolean | Is enabled |
|   ↳ `is_global` | boolean | Is global |
|   ↳ `last_run_at` | string | Last run at |
|   ↳ `name` | string | Name |
|   ↳ `project_ids` | array | Project ids |
|   ↳ `run_count` | number | Run count |
|   ↳ `scope` | string | Scope |
|   ↳ `status` | string | Status |
|   ↳ `updated_at` | string | Updated at |

### Plane Create a property context

Create a property context in Plane. Requires API v2.

#### Input

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --------- | ---- | -------- | ----------- |
| `apiKey` | string | Yes | Plane personal access token from Profile → API tokens. |
| `baseUrl` | string | No | Plane instance origin, optionally with a reverse-proxy path prefix. Defaults to https://api.plane.so. Do not include /api/v1 or /api/v2. |
| `apiVersion` | string | No | API version: v2 \(default\) for Plane Cloud and current commercial instances; v1 for Community Edition or older self-hosted instances. Unsupported operations or fields fail explicitly. |
| `bodyOverrides` | json | No | JSON overrides using the canonical input names for the selected API version. Preserves empty strings, null, and empty arrays; unsupported fields are rejected. |
| `workspace_slug` | string | Yes | Workspace slug from the Plane URL \(for example, my-team\). |
| `property_id` | string | Yes | The workspace-level property the context belongs to. A project-level property id is not addressable here and returns `404 not_found`. |
| `name` | string | No | Display name, unique among this property's contexts. Maximum 255 characters. Always send one — the context Plane seeded with the property already occupies the name `Default`. |
| `applies_to_all_projects` | boolean | No | Set to `true` to cover every project in the workspace instead of listing them. Defaults to `false`, which means `project_ids` is required. Only one context per property may set this to `true`, and the seeded context normally holds that slot, so a second all-projects context returns `400`. |
| `project_ids` | json | No | The exact projects this context covers. Required when `applies_to_all_projects` is `false`, and rejected with a `400` when it is `true` — the flag and the list are alternatives, never a combination. Every id must belong to this workspace, and duplicates are rejected. This field is write-only as an input, but the resulting links are echoed back in the response's read-only `project_ids`. |
| `applies_to_all_work_item_types` | boolean | No | Set to `true` to cover every work item type in the workspace instead of listing them. Defaults to `false`, which means `issue_type_ids` is required. |
| `issue_type_ids` | json | No | The exact work item types this context covers. Required when `applies_to_all_work_item_types` is `false`, and rejected with a `400` when it is `true`. Every id must belong to this workspace, and duplicates are rejected. Write-only as an input; the response echoes the stored links in `issue_type_ids`. |
| `is_required` | boolean | No | Whether the property must be filled in on work items inside this scope. This replaces the property's own `is_required` here — it does not combine with it. |
| `is_multi` | boolean | No | Whether the property accepts several values inside this scope. Replaces the property's own `is_multi` here. |
| `default_value` | json | No | Values applied when a work item in this scope has nothing set. For `OPTION` properties, any option in this context flagged `is_default` takes precedence over this array. |
| `options` | json | No | The choices this context offers for an `OPTION` property. Options belong to a context, so this list — not the property's full option list — is what work items in this scope can pick from. Each entry either references an existing option of the property or creates a new one: - `id` _string \(uuid\)_ — an existing option of this property. Duplicate ids and ids from another property are rejected. - `name` _string_ — creates a new option. Maximum 255 characters. Names must be unique within the payload, case-insensitively. - `description` _string_ — free-form description of the option. - `is_default` _boolean_ — preselect this option for new work items in this scope. Defaults to `false`. Send either `id` or `name` on each entry — an entry with neither is a `400`. Write-only as an input; the response returns the resulting options with their ids. An option's own `sort_order` is read-only: Plane assigns it from the order of the entries you send, and it is returned on each option in the response. |
| `settings` | json | No | Type-specific configuration for this scope, as a JSON object. Replaces the property's own `settings` here. |
| `sort_order` | number | No | Ordering weight among this property's contexts. Lower values sort first. Omit it and Plane places the new context after the ones that already exist. Ordering is presentational — it does not affect which context wins. |
| `external_id` | string | No | Your system's identifier for this context, for sync and import correlation. Maximum 255 characters. Must be sent together with `external_source`, and the pair must be unique within the property. |
| `external_source` | string | No | The system `external_id` came from, for example `github` or `jira`. Maximum 255 characters. Must be sent together with `external_id`. |
| `fields` | string | No | Comma-separated list of fields to return. Unrequested keys are **omitted** from the response, not returned as `null`, so absent means "not requested" and `null` means "actually null". `id` always comes back whether or not you name it. Pass `all` for every requestable field. An unknown name is a `400` that lists the valid set and suggests the closest match, so a typo can't silently cost you the saving. Requestable here: `applies_to_all_projects`, `applies_to_all_work_item_types`, `created_at`, `default_value`, `external_id`, `external_source`, `id`, `is_default`, `is_multi`, `is_required`, `issue_type_ids`, `name`, `options`, `project_ids`, `settings`, `sort_order`. See \[Sparse fields\]\(/api-reference/v2/sparse-fields\). |

#### Output

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --------- | ---- | ----------- |
| `result` | object | Plane V2 Work- Item- Property- Contexts |
|   ↳ `id` | string | Unique identifier for the context. |
|   ↳ `name` | string | Display name, unique among the contexts of this property. Maximum 255 characters. |
|   ↳ `is_required` | boolean | Whether the property must be filled in inside this scope. Overrides the property's own `is_required`. |
|   ↳ `is_multi` | boolean | Whether the property accepts several values inside this scope. Overrides the property's own `is_multi`. |
|   ↳ `is_default` | boolean | `true` on the context Plane seeded with the property. It is a marker only — precedence is decided by the scope flags, not by this field. |
|   ↳ `default_value` | array | Values applied when a work item in this scope has nothing set. For `OPTION` properties, options in this context flagged `is_default` take precedence over this array. |
|   ↳ `settings` | json | Settings |
|   ↳ `sort_order` | json | Sort order |
|   ↳ `applies_to_all_projects` | boolean | When `true`, the context covers every project in the workspace and `project_ids` is empty. When `false`, `project_ids` is the exact list of projects covered. |
|   ↳ `applies_to_all_work_item_types` | boolean | When `true`, the context covers every work item type and `issue_type_ids` is empty. When `false`, `issue_type_ids` is the exact list of types covered. |
|   ↳ `external_id` | string | External id |
|   ↳ `external_source` | string | External source |
|   ↳ `created_at` | string | When the context was created. |
|   ↳ `project_ids` | array | The ids of the projects this context covers. Empty when `applies_to_all_projects` is `true` — read the flag before reading this list. |
|   ↳ `issue_type_ids` | array | The ids of the work item types this context covers. Empty when `applies_to_all_work_item_types` is `true`. |
|   ↳ `options` | array | The choices this context offers for an `OPTION` property. Each entry has `id`, `name`, `is_default`, and `sort_order`. Options belong to a context, not to the property, so two contexts on the same property can offer different lists. |
|     ↳ `id` | string | Asset Id |
|     ↳ `name` | string | Asset Id |
|     ↳ `is_default` | boolean | Has Pages |
|     ↳ `sort_order` | number | Access |

### Plane Create a work item

Create a work item in Plane. Supports API v1 compatibility.

#### Input

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --------- | ---- | -------- | ----------- |
| `apiKey` | string | Yes | Plane personal access token from Profile → API tokens. |
| `baseUrl` | string | No | Plane instance origin, optionally with a reverse-proxy path prefix. Defaults to https://api.plane.so. Do not include /api/v1 or /api/v2. |
| `apiVersion` | string | No | API version: v2 \(default\) for Plane Cloud and current commercial instances; v1 for Community Edition or older self-hosted instances. Unsupported operations or fields fail explicitly. |
| `bodyOverrides` | json | No | JSON overrides using the canonical input names for the selected API version. Preserves empty strings, null, and empty arrays; unsupported fields are rejected. |
| `workspace_slug` | string | Yes | Workspace slug from the Plane URL \(for example, my-team\). |
| `project_id` | string | Yes | The project to create the work item in. |
| `name` | string | Yes | Title of the work item. Maximum 255 characters. The only required field. |
| `description_html` | string | No | Rich-text body as HTML, for example `Steps to reproduce…`. The HTML is sanitized on the way in; content that can't be sanitized is rejected with a `400`. `description_html` is **not** part of the read shape, so it will not appear in the response. |
| `priority` | string | No | One of `urgent`, `high`, `medium`, `low`, `none`. Defaults to `none`. |
| `state_id` | string | No | The workflow state to create the work item in. Must be a state of this project. Omit it and the work item lands in the project's default state. |
| `state` | string | No | The state's **name** instead of its id, for example `In Progress`. Matched case-insensitively within the project. Write-only. Unknown name or a name that matches more than one state is a `400`. Sending both `state` and `state_id` is a `400`. |
| `type_id` | string | No | The work item type. Accepts a type owned by the project and a workspace-level type imported into it. Requires work item types to be enabled. |
| `type` | string | No | The type's **name** instead of its id, for example `Bug`. Matched case-insensitively among the project's non-epic types. Write-only. |
| `parent_id` | string | No | The parent work item. The parent must be in the same workspace, but it may live in a different project. |
| `parent` | string | No | The parent's **identifier** instead of its id, for example `PROJ-118`. Resolved within the workspace. Write-only. |
| `assignee_ids` | json | No | User ids to assign. Each must be an active, assignable member of the project. Leave it out and the project's default assignee is applied, if one is configured. Send `\[\]` to create the work item with no assignee at all. |
| `assignees` | json | No | Member **email addresses** instead of ids, for example `\["ana@example.com"\]`. Every address must belong to an active, assignable project member — any that don't are named in the `400`. Write-only. |
| `label_ids` | json | No | Label ids to apply. Each must be a label of this project, or a workspace-level label available to it. |
| `labels` | json | No | Label **names** instead of ids, for example `\["regression", "auth"\]`. Matched case-insensitively against the project's labels and the workspace-level labels available to it. A name that exists at both levels is ambiguous and returns a `400` telling you to use `label_ids`. Write-only. |
| `estimate_point_id` | string | No | The estimate point to assign, from the project's active estimate system. |
| `estimate` | string | No | The estimate point's **value** instead of its id, for example `5` or `L`. Resolved against the project's active estimate. Write-only. |
| `start_date` | string | No | Planned start, for example `2026-01-12`. Must not be after `target_date`. |
| `target_date` | string | No | Planned due date, for example `2026-01-20`. |
| `external_id` | string | No | Your system's identifier for this work item, for sync and import correlation. Maximum 255 characters. Stored and filterable on \[List work items\]\(/api-reference/v2/work-items/list-work-items\), but not returned on reads. |
| `external_source` | string | No | The system `external_id` came from, for example `github` or `jira`. Maximum 255 characters. |
| `fields` | string | No | Comma-separated list of fields to return. Unrequested keys are **omitted** from the response, not returned as `null`, so absent means "not requested" and `null` means "actually null". `id` always comes back whether or not you name it. Pass `all` for every requestable field. An unknown name is a `400` that lists the valid set and suggests the closest match, so a typo can't silently cost you the saving. Requestable here: `archived_at`, `assignee_ids`, `created_at`, `created_by_id`, `custom_fields`, `cycle_id`, `id`, `identifier`, `is_draft`, `label_ids`, `module_ids`, `name`, `parent_id`, `priority`, `project_id`, `sequence_id`, `start_date`, `state_id`, `target_date`, `type_id`. See \[Sparse fields\]\(/api-reference/v2/sparse-fields\). |
| `expand` | string | No | Comma-separated relations to embed alongside the ids: `assignees` \(the assigned users\), `cycle` \(the cycle it belongs to\), `labels` \(the applied labels\), `modules` \(the modules it belongs to\), `parent` \(its parent work item\), `state` \(the work item's state object\), `type` \(its work item type\). Expansion is separate-key: `?expand=state` keeps `state_id` and adds a `state` object next to it, so an id is never replaced by an object. An unknown value is a `400`. `?fields=` and `?expand=` are independent namespaces. Relation names are not valid `?fields=` tokens \(and vice versa\), and an expanded object survives field filtering — `?fields=id,name&expand=state` returns `id`, `name` and `state`. See \[Expanding relations\]\(/api-reference/v2/expanding-relations\). |
| `deleted_at` | string | No | v1 compatibility only. Deleted at. |
| `point` | number | No | v1 compatibility only. Point. |
| `sequence_id` | number | No | v1 compatibility only. Sequence id. |
| `sort_order` | number | No | v1 compatibility only. Sort order. |
| `archived_at` | string | No | v1 compatibility only. Archived at. |
| `is_draft` | boolean | No | v1 compatibility only. Is draft. |
| `created_by` | string | No | v1 compatibility only. Created by. |
| `created_at` | string | No | v1 compatibility only. Creation timestamp for imports. |

#### Output

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --------- | ---- | ----------- |
| `result` | object | Plane V2 Work- Items |
|   ↳ `id` | json | Id |
|   ↳ `name` | json | Name |
|   ↳ `identifier` | string | The human key, for example `PROJ-142`. It is the project's identifier joined to `sequence_id`, and it is what people paste into chat and commit messages. Use it with \[Get a work item by identifier\]\(/api-reference/v2/work-items/get-work-item-by-identifier\) when you don't have the project UUID. |
|   ↳ `sequence_id` | json | Sequence id |
|   ↳ `priority` | json | Priority |
|   ↳ `state_id` | string | The workflow state the work item is currently in. |
|   ↳ `type_id` | string | Type id |
|   ↳ `assignee_ids` | array | User ids assigned to the work item. Empty array when unassigned. |
|   ↳ `label_ids` | array | Label ids applied to the work item. Empty array when unlabeled. |
|   ↳ `parent_id` | string | The parent work item, or `null` for a top-level item. A parent may live in another project of the same workspace. |

| `baseUrl` | string | No | Plane instance origin, optionally with a reverse-proxy path prefix. Defaults to https://api.plane.so. Do not include /api/v1 or /api/v2. |
| `apiVersion` | string | No | API version: v2 \(default\) for Plane Cloud and current commercial instances; v1 for Community Edition or older self-hosted instances. Unsupported operations or fields fail explicitly. |
| `bodyOverrides` | json | No | JSON overrides using the canonical input names for the selected API version. Preserves empty strings, null, and empty arrays; unsupported fields are rejected. |
| `workspace_slug` | string | Yes | Workspace slug from the Plane URL \(for example, my-team\). |
| `project_id` | string | Yes | The project to define the property in. Project-level properties belong to this project alone. |
| `display_name` | string | Yes | The human-readable label for the field, for example `Severity`. Maximum 255 characters. Plane derives the read-only `name` slug from this value and returns both. |
| `property_type` | string | Yes | What kind of data the field holds. This is the decision that shapes everything else about the property. - `TEXT` — Free-form text - `DATETIME` — A point in time, written as an ISO 8601 timestamp - `DECIMAL` — A number, carried as a string in the value array - `BOOLEAN` — A yes/no flag - `OPTION` — A choice from a fixed set you define - `RELATION` — A reference to another record; pair it with `relation_type` - `URL` — A link - `EMAIL` — An email address - `FILE` — An uploaded file - `FORMULA` — A value Plane computes rather than one a person enters The full reference, including what each type means for the value you send on a work item, is on the \[properties overview\]\(/api-reference/v2/work-item-properties/overview#property-type-reference\). |
| `relation_type` | string | No | What a `RELATION` property points at. Only meaningful when `property_type` is `RELATION` — leave it out otherwise. - `ISSUE` — A work item - `USER` — A member - `RELEASE` — A release - `RICH_TEXT` — Rich text content |
| `description` | string | No | Free-form explanation of what the field is for. Worth filling in — it is the helper text people read when deciding what to type. |
| `options` | json | No | Write-only. Define the choices for an `OPTION` property inline, in the same request that creates it, instead of a second round-trip per choice. Each entry is a property option object — `name` is required, and `description`, `is_default`, `external_id`, and `external_source` are accepted. See \[Create a property option\]\(/api-reference/v2/work-item-property-options/create-property-option\) for the full field list. You never get `options` back in the shape you sent it. The response carries the resolved `options` array, with each choice's generated `id` and `sort_order`. |
| `is_multi` | boolean | No | Allow more than one value on a work item — a multi-select list of severities, a set of reviewers, several linked work items. Leave it off for a single-valued field. |
| `is_required` | boolean | No | Force a value to be present. Give a required property a `default_value` so existing flows have something to fall back on. |
| `is_active` | boolean | No | Whether the property is offered. Create it inactive if you want to define the field and its options now but roll it out later. |
| `default_value` | json | No | The value applied when none is supplied. **Always an array**, even for a single-valued property — a `DECIMAL` field that defaults to `3` is sent as `\["3"\]`, not `3`. A property with no default sends `\[\]` or omits the field. For an `OPTION` property, mark the default choice with `is_default` on the option itself rather than repeating it here. |
| `settings` | json | No | Free-form object holding type-specific configuration. What belongs in it depends entirely on `property_type`, so there is no single schema — send the whole object rather than assuming keys. |
| `validation_rules` | json | No | Free-form object holding type-specific validation constraints. Same shape caveat as `settings`. |
| `external_id` | string | No | Your system's identifier for this field, for sync and import correlation. Maximum 255 characters. |
| `external_source` | string | No | The system `external_id` came from, for example `jira` or `linear`. Maximum 255 characters. |
| `fields` | string | No | Comma-separated list of fields to return. Unrequested keys are **omitted** from the response, not returned as `null`, so absent means "not requested" and `null` means "actually null". `id` always comes back whether or not you name it. Pass `all` for every requestable field. An unknown name is a `400` that lists the valid set and suggests the closest match, so a typo can't silently cost you the saving. Requestable here: `created_at`, `default_value`, `description`, `display_name`, `external_id`, `external_source`, `id`, `is_active`, `is_multi`, `is_required`, `logo_props`, `name`, `options`, `property_type`, `relation_type`, `settings`, `validation_rules`. See \[Sparse fields\]\(/api-reference/v2/sparse-fields\). |

#### Output

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --------- | ---- | ----------- |
| `result` | object | Plane V2 Work- Item- Properties |
|   ↳ `id` | string | Unique identifier for the property. This is the id you pass when attaching the property to a type or managing its options. |
|   ↳ `name` | string | The machine-readable slug for the property, derived by Plane. Read-only — it is not a create or update body field. Use it when you need a stable key in your own storage. |
|   ↳ `display_name` | string | The human-readable label shown wherever the property is rendered. This is the field you **write** on create and update. Maximum 255 characters. |
|   ↳ `description` | string | Free-form explanation of what the field is for. Surfaced as helper text next to the field. |
|   ↳ `property_type` | string | What kind of data the property holds. One of `TEXT`, `DATETIME`, `DECIMAL`, `BOOLEAN`, `OPTION`, `RELATION`, `URL`, `EMAIL`, `FILE`, or `FORMULA`. See the \[property type reference\]\(#property-type-reference\) below. |
|   ↳ `relation_type` | string | Relation type |
|   ↳ `is_multi` | boolean | Whether the property accepts more than one value. A multi-select severity list, a set of assignable reviewers, several linked work items. |
|   ↳ `is_required` | boolean | Whether a value must be present. Turning this on for an existing property affects work items edited from then on — it does not retroactively fill in the blanks. |
|   ↳ `is_active` | boolean | Whether the property is currently offered. Deactivating is the reversible alternative to deleting: the definition and its recorded values stay, the field stops being offered on new edits. |
|   ↳ `default_value` | array | The value applied when none is supplied. Always an array, even for a single-valued property — a decimal that defaults to `3` is `\["3"\]`, not `3`. |
|   ↳ `options` | array | For `OPTION` properties, the resolved list of choices. Each entry is a property option object with its own `id`, `name`, `is_default`, and `sort_order`. Manage them through \[Property options\]\(/api-reference/v2/work-item-property-options/list-property-options\), or define them inline when you \[create the property\]\(/api-reference/v2/work-item-properties/create-work-item-property\). |
|     ↳ `id` | string | Asset Id |
|     ↳ `name` | string | Asset Id |
|     ↳ `description` | string | Asset Id |
|     ↳ `is_default` | boolean | Has Pages |
|     ↳ `sort_order` | number | Access |
|     ↳ `external_id` | string | Asset Id |
|     ↳ `external_source` | string | Asset Id |
|   ↳ `settings` | json | Settings |
|   ↳ `validation_rules` | json | Validation rules |
|   ↳ `logo_props` | json | Logo props |
|   ↳ `external_id` | string | External id |
|   ↳ `external_source` | string | External source |
|   ↳ `created_at` | string | When the property was created. |

|   ↳ `name` | string | The choice as it is displayed. Maximum 255 characters. |
|   ↳ `description` | string | Free-form text explaining when to pick this choice. |

### Plane Create a workspace work item property

Create a workspace work item property in Plane. Requires API v2.

#### Input

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --------- | ---- | -------- | ----------- |
| `apiKey` | string | Yes | Plane personal access token from Profile → API tokens. |
| `baseUrl` | string | No | Plane instance origin, optionally with a reverse-proxy path prefix. Defaults to https://api.plane.so. Do not include /api/v1 or /api/v2. |
| `apiVersion` | string | No | API version: v2 \(default\) for Plane Cloud and current commercial instances; v1 for Community Edition or older self-hosted instances. Unsupported operations or fields fail explicitly. |
| `bodyOverrides` | json | No | JSON overrides using the canonical input names for the selected API version. Preserves empty strings, null, and empty arrays; unsupported fields are rejected. |
| `workspace_slug` | string | Yes | Workspace slug from the Plane URL \(for example, my-team\). |
| `display_name` | string | Yes | The label shown wherever the property is rendered. Maximum 255 characters. |
| `property_type` | string | Yes | What kind of value the property holds. Choose carefully — it governs what `relation_type`, `options`, `settings`, and `validation_rules` mean. - `TEXT` — free-form text - `DATETIME` — a date and time - `DECIMAL` — a number - `BOOLEAN` — true or false - `OPTION` — a choice from a defined list - `RELATION` — a pointer to another record; pair it with `relation_type` - `URL` — a link - `EMAIL` — an email address - `FILE` — a file - `FORMULA` — a formula-backed value A value outside this list is a `400 invalid_request`. |
| `relation_type` | string | No | For a `RELATION` property, what it points at. One of `ISSUE`, `USER`, `RELEASE`, or `RICH_TEXT`. Leave it out — or send `null` — for every other property type. |
| `description` | string | No | Free-form explanation of what the property captures. Nullable. |
| `is_required` | boolean | No | Whether a value must be supplied for this property. |
| `is_multi` | boolean | No | Whether the property accepts more than one value. |
| `is_active` | boolean | No | Whether the property is in use. Send `false` to define a property without putting it into circulation yet. |
| `default_value` | json | No | The value applied when none is supplied. Send an array even for a single value. |
| `options` | json | No | Seed the choices for an `OPTION` property in the same call. Write-only: the created options come back on the read-only `options` array of the response, and are managed afterwards through \[Property options\]\(/api-reference/v2/workspace-work-item-property-options/overview\), which is also where the fields an option accepts are documented. |
| `settings` | json | No | Type-specific configuration. Its shape depends on `property_type`. |
| `validation_rules` | json | No | Type-specific validation configuration. |
| `external_id` | string | No | Your system's identifier for this property, for sync and import correlation. Maximum 255 characters, nullable. |
| `external_source` | string | No | The system `external_id` came from, for example `github` or `jira`. Maximum 255 characters, nullable. |
| `fields` | string | No | Comma-separated list of fields to return. Unrequested keys are **omitted** from the response, not returned as `null`, so absent means "not requested" and `null` means "actually null". `id` always comes back whether or not you name it. Pass `all` for every requestable field. An unknown name is a `400` that lists the valid set and suggests the closest match, so a typo can't silently cost you the saving. Requestable here: `created_at`, `default_value`, `description`, `display_name`, `external_id`, `external_source`, `id`, `is_active`, `is_multi`, `is_required`, `logo_props`, `name`, `options`, `property_type`, `relation_type`, `settings`, `validation_rules`. See \[Sparse fields\]\(/api-reference/v2/sparse-fields\). |

#### Output

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --------- | ---- | ----------- |
| `result` | object | Plane V2 Workspace- Work- Item- Properties |
|   ↳ `id` | string | Unique identifier for the property. This is the id you use in a context's payload and when attaching the property to a workspace work item type. |
|   ↳ `name` | string | Read-only companion to `display_name`. You never set it directly. |

|   ↳ `property_type` | string | What kind of value the property holds. One of `TEXT`, `DATETIME`, `DECIMAL`, `BOOLEAN`, `OPTION`, `RELATION`, `URL`, `EMAIL`, `FILE`, or `FORMULA`. This is the one decision worth getting right up front — it determines what the other fields mean. |
|   ↳ `relation_type` | string | Relation type |
|   ↳ `is_required` | boolean | Whether a value must be supplied for this property. |
|   ↳ `is_multi` | boolean | Whether the property accepts more than one value. |
|   ↳ `is_active` | boolean | Whether the property is in use. Set it to `false` to retire a property without deleting it. |
|   ↳ `default_value` | array | The value applied when none is supplied. Always an array, even when `is_multi` is `false`. |
|   ↳ `options` | array | The choices for an `OPTION` property. Read-only on this object — manage the list through \[Property options\]\(/api-reference/v2/workspace-work-item-property-options/overview\), or seed it at create time with the write-only `options` body field. |
|     ↳ `id` | string | Asset Id |
|     ↳ `name` | string | Asset Id |
|     ↳ `description` | string | Asset Id |
|     ↳ `is_default` | boolean | Has Pages |
|     ↳ `sort_order` | number | Access |
|     ↳ `external_id` | string | Asset Id |
|     ↳ `external_source` | string | Asset Id |
|   ↳ `settings` | json | Settings |
|   ↳ `validation_rules` | json | Validation rules |
|   ↳ `logo_props` | json | Logo props |
|   ↳ `external_id` | string | External id |
|   ↳ `external_source` | string | External source |
|   ↳ `created_at` | string | When the property was created. |

Pass `all` for every requestable field. An unknown name is a `400` that lists the valid set and suggests the closest match, so a typo can't silently cost you the saving. Requestable here: `created_at`, `description`, `id`, `is_active`, `is_default`, `is_epic`, `level`, `logo_props`, `name`. See \[Sparse fields\]\(/api-reference/v2/sparse-fields\). |

| --------- | ---- | ----------- |
| `result` | object | Plane V2 Workspace- Work- Item- Types |
|   ↳ `id` | string | Unique identifier for the type. This is the id you send as `type_id` on a work item, and the id you pass when importing types into a project. |
|   ↳ `name` | string | Display name, for example `Bug`. Maximum 255 characters. |
|   ↳ `description` | string | What this type is for. Shown next to the type wherever it is picked in Plane, so it is worth writing for the people choosing, not for your integration. |
|   ↳ `is_active` | boolean | Whether the type can currently be selected. Deactivating a type retires it from pickers without deleting it or touching the work items already using it. |
|   ↳ `is_default` | boolean | Whether this is the workspace's default type. Read-only on create and update — change it with \[Mark a type as default\]\(/api-reference/v2/workspace-work-item-types/mark-default-workspace-work-item-type\). |

### Plane Enable work item types

Enable work item types in Plane. Requires API v2.

#### Input

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --------- | ---- | -------- | ----------- |
| `apiKey` | string | Yes | Plane personal access token from Profile → API tokens. |
| `baseUrl` | string | No | Plane instance origin, optionally with a reverse-proxy path prefix. Defaults to https://api.plane.so. Do not include /api/v1 or /api/v2. |
| `apiVersion` | string | No | API version: v2 \(default\) for Plane Cloud and current commercial instances; v1 for Community Edition or older self-hosted instances. Unsupported operations or fields fail explicitly. |
| `workspace_slug` | string | Yes | Workspace slug from the Plane URL \(for example, my-team\). |
| `project_id` | string | Yes | The project to turn work item types on for. |
| `fields` | string | No | Comma-separated list of fields to return. Unrequested keys are **omitted** from the response, not returned as `null`, so absent means "not requested" and `null` means "actually null". `id` always comes back whether or not you name it. Pass `all` for every requestable field. An unknown name is a `400` that lists the valid set and suggests the closest match, so a typo can't silently cost you the saving. Requestable here: `created_at`, `description`, `id`, `is_active`, `is_default`, `is_epic`, `level`, `logo_props`, `name`. See \[Sparse fields\]\(/api-reference/v2/sparse-fields\). |

#### Output

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --------- | ---- | ----------- |
| `result` | object | Plane V2 Work- Item- Types |
|   ↳ `id` | string | Unique identifier for the type. This is the value you send as `type_id` when creating a work item, and the `\{type_id\}` in the type-properties paths. |
|   ↳ `name` | string | Display name, for example `Bug`. Maximum 255 characters. |
|   ↳ `description` | string | Free-form explanation of when this type should be used. Worth filling in — an integration or agent reading the \[schema endpoint\]\(/api-reference/v2/work-item-types/get-work-item-type-schema\) sees this text as `type_description` and uses it to choose between types. |
|   ↳ `is_active` | boolean | Whether the type can be assigned to new work items. Deactivating a type hides it from pickers without deleting it or touching the work items that already use it. |
|   ↳ `is_default` | boolean | Whether new work items land on this type when no `type_id` is supplied. Exactly one type per project holds the flag. It is not writable through create or update — move it with \[Mark a work item type as default\]\(/api-reference/v2/work-item-types/mark-default-work-item-type\). |
|   ↳ `is_epic` | boolean | Whether this is the project's epic type. Read-only — epics are provisioned by Plane, not authored through this endpoint. |
|   ↳ `level` | json | Level |
|   ↳ `logo_props` | json | Logo props |
|   ↳ `created_at` | string | When the type was created. |
